sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 30 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Removes Insanity from all allies.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Reduces Dark Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage by 30% when equipped in the main slot.
